svg.title: The 5 file layouts we tested
svg.desc: SEP: one file per camera. STACK: the 3 views in one tall video. BIG: SEP with files 3x longer. MULTI: one file with 3 video tracks. Equal size: STACK and MULTI cut to SEP's file size.
svg.text: What we tested: 5 ways to store the same 3 cameras
The same frames in every layout. Each square is one frame. Its color is the camera.
One MP4 per camera. This is LeRobot v3 today.
A frame needs 3 files and 3 decoders.
The 3 views stacked into one tall video.
A frame needs 1 file and 1 decoder.
Like SEP, but each file is 3x longer.
One MP4 with 3 video tracks, copied from SEP.
STACK and MULTI cut at keyframes
to the same size in bytes as SEP files.
All layouts use LeRobot's default AV1 settings. Details and file sizes: METHOD.md.
